Tooltip: Per-field hybrid search: query with a JSON object of field/value pairs. Exact-mode fields match by string equality (score 1.0); semantic-mode fields match by similarity. A row's score is the average across the scored keys, so rows matching more keys rank higher. Keys listed in Filter Columns are hard filters: non-matching rows are excluded rather than ranked lower. Returns whole rows.

Arguments.Name: in_QueryJson
Arguments.Tooltip: JSON object of field/value pairs, e.g. {"Name":"جامعة هارفارد","Rank":"5"}. Keys must match ingested column names (case-insensitive). Each key is scored by its stored mode: exact = string equality, semantic = similarity.

Arguments.Name: in_FilterColumns
Arguments.Tooltip: Optional. Query keys listed here act as hard filters instead of score contributors: a row is returned only if every listed key matches the queried value exactly (trimmed, case-insensitive), whatever mode it was ingested in. Filter keys do not affect the score, which is averaged across the remaining keys. Leave empty to score every key (the original behaviour).

Arguments.Name: in_SharePath
Arguments.Tooltip: Full path of the canonical store.db (usually on a network share). Never opened directly - a local copy is synced first, only when the share is newer.

Arguments.Name: in_LocalDbPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Where this machine keeps its local read copy of the store, e.g. C:\rag\read\store.db. Created automatically.

Arguments.Name: in_EmbeddingUrl
Arguments.Tooltip: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (POST .../v1/embeddings). Every queried value is embedded, including exact and filter keys - the stored mode is only known after the embedding call.

Arguments.Name: in_ApiKey
Arguments.Tooltip: Bearer token for the embedding endpoint. Leave empty for anonymous endpoints. Source from an Orchestrator Credential asset - never hardcode.

Arguments.Name: in_Model
Arguments.Tooltip: Model name sent to the endpoint. MUST match the model the store was ingested with (stored in the meta table, e.g. BAAI/bge-m3) or scores are meaningless.

Arguments.Name: in_TopK
Arguments.Tooltip: How many best-matching rows to return. Typical: 5.

Arguments.Name: in_TimeoutSec
Arguments.Tooltip: HTTP timeout per embedding call. Allow extra headroom for cold model starts (e.g. 120).

Arguments.Name: in_MaxRetries
Arguments.Tooltip: Retries for transient embedding failures (5xx, timeouts, 429). Permanent 4xx errors fail immediately without retrying.

Arguments.Name: out_dt_Results
Arguments.Tooltip: DataTable ranked best-first. Columns: Rank (Int32), DocId (String), ChunkIndex (Int32), Content (the FULL row JSON - every column of the matched record), Score (Double, average across queried keys).
